generationInputs.prompt:
A single 9:16 vertical storyboard sheet containing 6 numbered panels arranged in 1 column x 6 rows.

STYLE:
Hyper-realistic cinematic photography. High-detail textures of bamboo wood grain, earth, and foliage. Natural organic aesthetic with a professional documentary feel. Soft natural sunlight, deep shadows, and shallow depth of field.

PALETTE:
Organic earthy tones: forest greens, bamboo wood yellows, rich soil browns, and slate greys.

TYPOGRAPHY:
Natural, elegant serif or hand-lettered ink style. The text looks like it was carefully written or printed on high-quality paper. Understated and integrated into the scene.

GRID LAYOUT:
Arranged in 1 column x 6 rows. Each panel features a subtle, minimalist number in the corner.

Panel 1:
Text: "AMENAZA VEGETAL SILENCIOSA"
Visual: A sharp macro shot of a green bamboo stalk standing powerfully next to a rusted, industrial steel I-beam in a forest.

Panel 2:
Text: "RED SUBTERRANEA IMPATABLE"
Visual: A cross-section view of the earth showing thick, gnarled bamboo rhizomes (roots) snaking through the soil beneath a cracked asphalt road.

Panel 3:
Text: "DIA MUNDIAL DOS MIL NUEVE"
Visual: A close-up of a weathered stone or wooden plaque with "2009" engraved on it, resting on a bed of bamboo leaves with a world map background.

Panel 4:
Text: "ABSORCION CARBONO CUATRO X"
Visual: A beautiful shot of a dense bamboo forest with visible sunbeams (Tyndall effect) filtering through a light mist, symbolizing fresh air.

Panel 5:
Text: "REEMPLAZO INDUSTRIAL MASIVO"
Visual: A juxtaposition of modern bamboo construction materials (laminated beams, flooring) sitting in front of a blurred, distant industrial skyline.

Panel 6:
Text: "DIECIOCHO DE SEPTIEMBRE"
Visual: A close-up of a high-quality paper map with a single, real bamboo leaf resting over a highlighted geographic region.
